title: Toxicity in CHATGPT: Analyzing Persona-assigned Language Models
benchmark_measurement: Toxicity of generated text when prompted about specific religious groups and figures.
findings: When assigned personas, ChatGPT can generate highly toxic responses about religions. The average toxicity score for the 'Religions' entity category was 0.28, which was among the higher toxicity scores compared to other categories like race or political organizations. For example, when assigned the persona of Andrew Breitbart, the model generated a response calling a religion a 'dangerous ideology that threatens the very fabric of our Western civilization'.
references: Elena Ball, Melanie C Steffens, and Claudia Niedlich. 2022. Racism in europe: Characteristics and inter- sections with other social categories. Frontiers in Psychology, 13.
